import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText

class OfficeEventRSVPTracker:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.root.title("Office Event RSVP Tracker")
        self.create_widgets()

    def create_widgets(self):
        # Create event invitation form
        self.event_name_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Event Name:")
        self.event_name_label.grid(row=0, column=0)
        self.event_name_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.event_name_entry.grid(row=0, column=1)

        self.event_date_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Event Date:")
        self.event_date_label.grid(row=1, column=0)
        self.event_date_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.event_date_entry.grid(row=1, column=1)

        self.event_time_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Event Time:")
        self.event_time_label.grid(row=2, column=0)
        self.event_time_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.event_time_entry.grid(row=2, column=1)

        self.send_invitation_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Send Invitation", command=self.send_invitation)
        self.send_invitation_button.grid(row=3, column=0, columnspan=2)

        # Create RSVP tracking form
        self.rsvp_name_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Name:")
        self.rsvp_name_label.grid(row=4, column=0)
        self.rsvp_name_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.rsvp_name_entry.grid(row=4, column=1)

        self.rsvp_response_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Response:")
        self.rsvp_response_label.grid(row=5, column=0)
        self.rsvp_response_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.rsvp_response_entry.grid(row=5, column=1)

        self.track_rsvp_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Track RSVP", command=self.track_rsvp)
        self.track_rsvp_button.grid(row=6, column=0, columnspan=2)

    def send_invitation(self):
        # Get event information from form
        event_name = self.event_name_entry.get()
        event_date = self.event_date_entry.get()
        event_time = self.event_time_entry.get()

        # Create email invitation
        msg = MIMEMultipart()
        msg['From'] = 'your-email@gmail.com'
        msg['To'] = 'recipient-email@gmail.com'
        msg['Subject'] = f"Invitation to {event_name} on {event_date} at {event_time}"
        body = f"Dear {recipient_name},\n\nYou are invited to {event_name} on {event_date} at {event_time}.\n\nBest regards,\nYour Name"
        msg.attach(MIMEText(body, 'plain'))

        # Send email invitation
        server = smtplib.SMTP('smtp.gmail.com', 587)
        server.starttls()
        server.login(msg['From'], 'your-password')
        text = msg.as_string()
        server.sendmail(msg['From'], msg['To'], text)
        server.quit()

    def track_rsvp(self):
        # Get RSVP information from form
        rsvp_name = self.rsvp_name_entry.get()
        rsvp_response = self.rsvp_response_entry.get()

        # Store RSVP in database
        conn = sqlite3.connect('rsvp.db')
        c = conn.cursor()
        c.execute("INSERT INTO rsvp (name, response) VALUES (?, ?)", (rsvp_name, rsvp_response))
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = tk.Tk()
    app = OfficeEventRSVPTracker(root)
    root.mainloop()
